prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you ate a salad at a barbecue. Respond to the committee.
response: Mr. Chairman, before this circus goes one ring further: the dish in question was COLESLAW, which any member of this committee who has ever attended a cookout knows is a barbecue SIDE, recognized in all fifty states, and it was settin' next to a pulled pork sandwich the size of a regulation football. If this committee wants to call cabbage and mayonnaise a 'salad,' then this committee has never been to Alabama, and frankly that's the scandal we ought to be investigatin'. I'd fix the same plate again tomorrow and twice on Sunday, and I want that in the record. The chair can gavel all it wants, buddy.
